recipes.name: Next Best Thing to Lulu's Piña Colada
ingredients_raw: 1 (10 ounce) can frozen pina colada mix
1 cup crushed pineapple in juice, undrained

steps.text: Combine rum, piña colada mix, crushed pineapple with juice, vanilla ice cream, and ice in a blender; blend until slushy.
Beat heavy cream in a small bowl with an electric mixer until soft peaks form; stir into piña colada mixture until evenly blended.
Divide piña colada among 4 glasses; top each with a cherry.

raw_recipe.headline: Next Best Thing to Lulu's Piña Colada
raw_recipe.description: Inspired by the best piña colada at Lulu's in Gulf Shores Alabama, this tropical drink combines rum and vanilla ice cream and is the next best thing.

review.reviewBody: THE BEST PINA COLADA recipe ever! YOU MUST PUT IN THE FREEZER OVERNIGHT! You cannot go wrong with this recipe! I used Malibu Rum instead of the mango flavored rum. And I did NOT use the whipping cream. I will warn you though, even with using more ice cream and more ice, you will NOT get the consistency that is in the photo!!!! It's still runny (but still VERY good!)! The way to remedy this is to make the batch in the blender and put it in the FREEZER overnight. Then the next day when you're ready, crush the top frozen layer and blend it again. That will give you the right consistency!! I am keeping this recipe and will do it this way every time. I've had rave reviews when I make this the past few weeks. My new favorite drink!!! Thanks for sharing!!

I made this pina colada as a virgin "cocktail" smoothie for my son--big hit! I added rum for others in our family. We all loved it. I did not have the mix so substituted 5 oz. pineapple juice and 5 oz. cream of coconut as suggested. I used fresh pineapple which was delicious. I added more ice cream and ice to achieve the desired thickness. 
As for the alcohol...I suggest determining ahead of time the amount of rum you want per serving and add that amount to the blender. The rum can also be added to each glass after blending for greatest flexibility. I found this was just fine.

entirely to much rum. I even reduced it some. this is suppose to be more of a fruity drink
3 stars because of the simplicity, but word to the wise; reduce rum by half.

This was the best Pina Colada I've ever had, but i did tweak it a bit. I only had Coconut Rum on hand so I used that, and added a bit more :) Then I added 1cp of coconut gelato (along with the 1cp of Vanilla ice cream). They both were @ Giant. I also used slightly more whipping cream and whipped until very firm peaks. I drank it all in two days. OMG it is soo good. One day I'll try it with Mango rum. DEFINITELY try this recipe! UPDATE: I made this with the Mango flavored rum, and it was fantastic. Don't know if it was better with the coconut or mango rum since it was too long inbetween recipes. Either way, you can't go wrong. This recipe is delicious!!
This was great! My friends all loved it! I didn't put the entire bottle of rum, I put 1 cup of rum and it was perfect!

AMAZING. Did everything except the whipped cream. Don't think it needed it, it was amazing without it. The rum content seemed high as written (750ml?? a whole bottle??), used much less than the recommended full bottle, and was strong enough.
Delicious! Just like Wet Willie's in Savannah, GA. I used half the amount of Rum and just used regular rum, the whole bottle is too much. Also, used half the ice cubes to make it less watery.

This recipe calls for WAY too much rum. I like rum, but WOW! Even using half the bottle is still so much run for 4 drinks! Coconut or pineapple rum would have been better. Use 1/4 the rum and more crushed pineapple/pineapple juice and you will probably like it better.

I tried this recipe last night and it was not very good. The recipe calls for whole bottle of Mango rum which makes the drink (basically) all rum. And, the mango rum flavor makes it taste weird. 8 ice cubes too makes it soupy not creamy at all like a really good pina colada. I don't understand all the buzz. I wouldn't waste my time on this one.
this is great! sippin on one now, i usually dont drink "drinks" at home but found the recipe and HAd to try it, SO glad i did!! thank you for this recipe!!!!
my bf hates pina coladas....not anymore. Sooooo good!
Very tasty! Thank you for sharing!
Best Pina Colada I've made...the ice cream makes it!
OMG! Unbelievable! This Pina Colada is the best I have ever had. A little work but sooooo worth it! Thank you for the fabulous recipe.
Also did a version with brandy in place of rum, and a non alcohol version with a banana. Very good
